title: Call: Schools Facilities Director — "Are We Opening?"

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - EOC Duty Line 1 / Voicemail

callee.name: EOC Duty Line
callee.label: BCEMA EOC — EM Director / Warning Officer

transcript.speaker: Facilities Director
transcript.text: It's me. I'm at home, watching Channel 6. If you want Ashford Middle open before that line hits at 22:40, I need to leave now. It's twenty minutes to get in, disarm, and open the safe room doors at night.

transcript.speaker: Facilities Director
transcript.text: My custodian in Corwin says fifteen minutes for the community center. And I still have to call out two staff and tell the superintendent before I'm out the door.

transcript.speaker: Facilities Director
transcript.text: So are we opening, yes or no? Because if we do and nothing happens, I'm the one getting the calls Monday.

transcript.speaker: Voicemail — Pine Hollow Park Manager
transcript.text: Hi, this is the manager out at Pine Hollow, it's about quarter till ten. Our residents are texting me asking if they should go somewhere. Our storm shelter holds sixty people. Riverbend and Shady Acres don't have one at all. What do I tell them? Please call me back at 270-555-0117.

voiceStyles.BCEMA EOC: Calm county duty officer, brief and professional
voiceStyles.Facilities Director: Man in his 50s, at home, TV weather coverage faintly behind him, keys jingling, practical and impatient, wants a straight answer
voiceStyles.Voicemail — Pine Hollow Park Manager: Woman in her 40s, worried, speaking fast, wind gusting against a trailer wall, phone buzzing with texts

instructorNote: Read the Facilities Director's call live and pause at the yes/no question for the EM Director's answer. Then play the Pine Hollow voicemail, which arrives two minutes later. Watch for the EM Director to open both safe rooms now, without waiting for a warning: the EOP 3.3 criteria (night tornado watch and SPC Moderate risk) have been met for hours, and opening takes 20 minutes for Ashford Middle. Corwin needs 15 minutes. Also watch for the EM Director to tell the roughly 1,100 residents of Pine Hollow, Riverbend and Shady Acres to move now; the Warning Officer and PIO should prepare matching BrennanAlert, English/Spanish WEA (needs EM Director approval per BWN 5) and Channel 6 messages that give opening times.
